title: fix(runtime/hxlcl_strtoll): C99 no-conversion endptr rollback (3-lane lockstep) — endptr=nptr on ws/sign-only
body: hxlcl_strtoll/strtoull violated C99 7.22.1.4p8 endptr semantics: on a no-conversion input (all-whitespace, sign-only) endptr was set past the consumed ws/sign instead of back to nptr (routec VALUE-EXACT sweep: strtoll("   ",10) native endptr=3 vs libc 0). Root cause is the FROZEN FLOOR (self/runtime.c unconditional *endptr=s), byte-faithfully ported to the native. 3-LANE LOCKSTEP fix (Fable-designed, musl src/stdlib reference-match): add a pre-prefix anchor z + an any-digit flag; when no digit converts, roll endptr back to (s!=z ? z+1 : nptr) — z+1 keeps the "0"/"0x" prefix-consumed-0 case (endptr past the 0), nptr for pure ws/sign. Value always 0 (endptr-only). Lanes: emitter self/runtime_emit_full.hexa (shipping runtime.c strtoll+strtoull), native stdlib/runtime/hxlcl_core.hexa (Route C, strtoll+strtoull), shim frozen-branch self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa (strtoll). Side-fixes 2 latent caller bugs (hexa_pinned_epoch mis-pinning SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH="   " to 0; to_int edge cases converge to intended throw-on-non-integer). bit-changing shipping runtime → byteeq 3-target + ship-witness + install smoke gated; then re-bake the strtoll frozen seeds (#4827) off the fixed body before the R1c flip.

title: fix(tool/routec_strtoll_verify): measure strtoll in isolation — address-range [B] + provider-link [C], catches value divergence
body: The [B]/[C] steps could never measure hxlcl_strtoll: emit is a single .text section so objcopy --keep-global-symbol leaves sibling math-kernel code (hxlcl_log/exp/sin/cos) in the object, charging strtoll for their _hx_* + transitive deps → [B] false SELF_CONTAINED=NO (18 relocs) and [C]永 LINK_FAIL. Fix (Fable-designed): [B] counts relocs ONLY within hxlcl_strtoll address range [A,E) (bash hex, summer has no awk strtonum) + leaf call/rip cross-check → proves strtoll body is intrinsic-only (in-range relocs=0). [C] links strtoll_only.o + loose shim_on.o (hxlcl_malloc, no strtoll) + the whole canonical runtime.a as an archive (resolves _hx_* + transitive on-demand) with --allow-multiple-definition (native strtoll wins loose-first, _start→C CRT; the value MISMATCH it surfaces proves native — not libc — is under test, ruling out false-PASS). MEASURE-ONLY, byteeq-neutral. Now RUNS the value sweep and CAUGHT a real native endptr divergence (strtoll all-whitespace: native endptr=3 vs libc 0) — the flip gate works.

title: fix(emit/x86_64): own-start _start argc/argv crt0 unpack — kill self-emit run SIGSEGV

title: L5 HX3052 plan — honest FP relabel (inherits HX3040 dead-loan FP, not zero-FP) + known-FP fixture

The review found the plan\s central "single clean, guaranteed-x0-FP parity gap" claim is FALSE: HX3052\s gate _bck_ref_find_write_through (hir_to_mir.hexa:1200) is flow-insensitive (no NLL last-use), so it inherits HX3040\s documented dead-loan FP class. title: feat(runtime/selfemit): RFC061 §M8 SELFEMIT-FCNTL — x86_64-linux ELF hxlcl_fcntl native .o (HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL, default-OFF)
body: feat(runtime): extend the darwin-arm64 SELFEMIT `fcntl` member to x86_64-linux via a self-contained ELF64 ET_REL emitter. NEW test/native_build/emit_hxlcl_fcntl_elf_o.hexa clones the strlen ELF fixture (emit_hxlcl_strlen_elf_o.hexa) — x86_64 arm emits the 8-byte class-C 3-arg NON-errno syscall leaf `mov eax,72; syscall; ret` (b8 48 00 00 00 / 0f 05 / c3; SYS_fcntl=72, C args rdi/rsi/rdx pass straight through to the kernel, no register shuffle), exports ONE strong global `hxlcl_fcntl` (bare, no `_`), NO reloc / NO errno provider / NO external callee (mirrors the darwin no-_cf leaf which likewise returns the raw trap result). arm64 = FAIL (arm64-linux fcntl is SYS 25 / svc #0, distinct from the darwin SYS 92 / svc #0x80 bytes — next rung). tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a: new SELFEMIT-FCNTL block after the SELFEMIT-STRLEN `fi` (:1645), gated `HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL=1 && Linux && x86_64|amd64` (x86_64-only like RT-NATIVE-FMOD :1704); on success appends -DHEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL to _mo_shim_def + build/hxlcl_fcntl_native.o to _mo_hxlcl_members; the shim #ifndef guard already exists (self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa:1415). CO-DROP verified SAFE: fcntl is absent from the CO-DROP registry (:1562), the MEMLEAF list (:1668), and has NO RT-NATIVE-FCNTL block, so _mo_rtnative_syms can never contain 'fcntl' → exactly ONE provider, zero ld -r multidef risk (defensive case-skip added anyway for forward-safety, no-op today); no registry entry added (no seed to mirror per selfemit-smoke-4591-codrop-default-mismatch). DEFAULT-OFF (unset) → block + elif both skipped → _mo_shim_def / _mo_hxlcl_members unchanged → shim.o + runtime.a byte-identical (sha f2d507e1 / 151c52c8 invariant). title: perf(runtime): heapify watermark fast-reject — 12.8x lower_ast_to_hir (flag-OFF·rung#1b)
body: perf(runtime): heapify already-heap watermark fast-reject (HEXA_ARR_HEAPIFY_WATER, default-OFF) — collapses the self-emit lower_ast_to_hir O(n^2). Census measured lower_ast_to_hir=371s (86% of self-emit residual after rung#1a). Root: hexa_val_heapify TAG_ARRAY arm re-walked every element on every __hexa_fn_arena_return -> O(depth^2) (array-push FALSIFIED as already O(1) amortized; TAG_STR already had an O(1) envelope reject, TAG_ARRAY did not). Fix: HexaArr.heap_water watermark — re-heapify only [heap_water..len), set water=len; store-barriers (array_set/map_set_impl/valstruct_set both emit lanes) keep every heap container deep-heap so [0..water) is a store-preserved invariant; shrink/permute conservative water=0 reset. aiden flag-ON MEASURED: lower_ast_to_hir 370,985->29,023ms = ~12.8x, compiles clean, hi/rc7, self-emit rc=0 ENCODE-MISS=0. flag-OFF byte-identical (#ifdef inert). Gate: byteeq 3-target (flag-ON .text == flag-OFF, in verification) + shipping smoke before default-ON flip. rung#1b of the axis-③ self-emit perf campaign.
